def B(c):
    return ZZ(1) if bool(c) else ZZ(0)
instances = [
    oracle_instance('Real.pi', '1', '_',
                    lhs=RIF(1^2/2 - cos(pi)),
                    rhs=RIF(1), relation='>', edge=True),
    oracle_instance('0', '3', '_',
                    lhs=RIF(3^2/2 - cos(0)),
                    rhs=RIF(1), relation='>', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('2', '3/2', '_',
